Elevate Double Hung Window

The Marvin Elevate® Double Hung window offers traditional style with superior strength. Tilt the sashes in or remove them for easy cleaning. Style meets durability with a low-maintenance Ultrex fiberglass exterior and warm wood interior.

Ultrex® fiberglass exterior with wood interior

Product Highlights

Natural Ventilation

Offers maximum circulation when both sashes are open.

Be confident in the strength of Ultrex fiberglass, which is 8x stronger than vinyl and 3x stronger than wood/vinyl composites.

Beauty + Durability

Exterior

Elevate Double Hung Window

Select Frame

The key difference between an Elevate Double Hung window and an Elevate Double Hung Insert window is that the Double Hung Insert window unit is fit into an existing window frame. Because siding and existing interior and exterior trim are left intact in this process, the Double Hung Insert option is generally quicker to install. An insert window is a great option when you’re happy with the size, shape, and operating style of your existing window.

Full frame window replacement involves complete removal of the existing window frame. The new window is then installed in the opening. While this process takes longer and requires the removal of trim (and occasionally siding), it allows a professional to better inspect for water or structural damage. A full frame window is ideal when you want to replace with a new style or size of window.


Elevate Double Hung Window

  • Ideal when a new style or size of window is desired, or when the existing window frame needs replacement

  • Allows for more thorough inspection of existing window frames

  • Up to PG50 performance rating for air, water, and structural integrity

  • Quicker installation

Elevate Double Hung Window (Insert)

  • Built to fit existing window openings within a fraction of an inch for precise frame-in-frame replacement

  • Double Hung Insert option features ¾" insert replacement frame with through jamb installation

  • Can be installed without removing the existing window frame

  • Up to PG40 performance rating for air, water, and structural integrity

  • Installation will not disturb existing trim or siding

Select operation

Elevate Double Hung Window

Operating double hung windows slide open to let fresh air inside the home. Two movable sashes create ventilation at the top, bottom, or both. Double hung windows offer maximum circulation when both sashes are open.

Elevate Double Hung Picture Window

Double hung picture windows do not operate and are often installed to showcase a view or as matching complements to a larger assembly of operating units.

Ultrex Fiberglass Exterior

Marvin Elevate products feature Ultrex fiberglass for superior durability and energy efficiency.

Holds shape up to 285° F

AAMA 624 verified finish

8x stronger than vinyl

Virtually maintenance free

Security Options


Window Opening Control Device

To meet standards created to assist in the prevention of window falls by children five years old and younger, this device limits the window opening to less than 4" when the sash is opened. Read more

Specialty Features


Superior Durability

Window exterior is made with Ultrex fiberglass, which offers superior strength and durability over vinyl and wood/vinyl composites.

Premium Finish

Acrylic finish is 3x thicker than competitive painted options​ and resists scratches, chipping, peeling, chalking, and fading, even in dark colors​.

Thermal Performance

Low thermal conductivity rate of Ultrex fiberglass, combined with energy-efficient glass, including dual- and triple-pane glass options on windows.

Coastal Protection

Available with Hurricane Zone 3 (IZ3) ratings to stand up to severe coastal conditions.

Screens

Screens for the Elevate product line feature Marvin Bright View™ mesh — a fiberglass screen mesh that provides improved airflow and more natural light while keeping insects out. Bright View repels water and resists dirt and grime for a sharp, vivid view.

For cohesive curb appeal, all exterior screens are available in colors to match Ultrex fiberglass window and door exteriors.

Marvin Bright View

Types

The look of multiple, individual panes of glass in a window or door is a popular option. Choose Grilles-Between-the-Glass (GBG), Simulated Divided Lite (SDL), or Simulated Divided Lite with Spacer Bar (SDLS).

Installation Information

Elevate windows are built for quick, easy installation.

Guides

Installation Guide
All Installation Guides

Nailing Fin

Pre-attached folding nailing fin and drip cap for easier installation.

Through Jamb

Available through jamb and installation bracket options.

Factory-Applied Jamb Extensions

Factory-applied jamb extensions save time and labor. We supply 4-⁹⁄₁₆", 6-⁹⁄₁₆", and 6-¹³⁄₁₆" jamb depth in bare wood, white, designer black, or clear interior finish.

Factory-Installed Screens

Factory-installed screens are a standard offering with operating windows. At no extra cost, we can ship your screens separately to reduce on-site damage prior to installation.

Corner Keys

Integral corner keys keeps window and door units square and corners sealed.

Custom Sizes

Custom sizes are available on windows and doors in ¹⁄₆₄" increments for the perfect fit every time.

Paintable Ultrex Exterior

The Ultrex fiberglass exterior is paintable, and it holds dark colors better than vinyl or vinyl/wood composites.

Factory-Mulled Assemblies Available

Standard factory mulling, reinforced factory mulling, or field mulling kits. The reinforced mull meets AAMA 450 specifications and performs up to PG50 on standard products and up to PG55 on Impact Zone 3 (IZ3) rated products.
